content.title: Weekly Horoscope Readings for Every Zodiac Sign: Apr 5–11
content.text: Your Weekly Horoscopes by Madame Clairevoyant: April 5–11 By , astrologer and Cut columnist. She has written weekly horoscopes for more than ten years and is the author of 'Madame Clairevoyant’s Guide to the Stars.' Photo-Illustration: by The Cut; Photos: Getty Images On Thursday afternoon, Mars joins the sun in Aries, where it’ll stay until mid-May. The planet of action is at its boldest and most confident now, making this an ideal time for making big moves and betting on yourself. Especially if you’re the sort of person who often manages to talk yourself out of pursuing what you truly want, now is the time to go for it. You might be a bit more reckless than usual, but that’s not always a bad thing: Sometimes, a bit of impulsivity is the best way to break out of a rut. Although you don’t mind being assertive — particularly when nobody else seems to have the will or desire to make things happen — you’re often afraid you’ll come across as pushy and obnoxious. And so it can seem like a good idea to curb your energy so you don’t appear too intense. This week, though, it might be time to stop letting your fear of others’ judgment hold you back. You’ve got big ambitions, and you owe it to yourself to pursue them, if only to see what happens. It’s occasionally necessary to make decisions based solely on intuition — maybe because reliable information isn’t available, or maybe because, whatever the facts say, you have a powerful gut feeling you can’t ignore. This week, the best thing you can do is pay attention to your instincts, even if you can’t initially figure out where they come from or why you feel the way they do. You don’t necessarily need to act on them right away — just don’t brush them aside, either. You’re good at connecting with all kinds of different personalities; your curiosity about people tends to make them want to open up to you. So over time, you’ve built up a broad network of friendships and connections, from the light and casual to the deep and lasting. This week, think about how you might mobilize your community to make things happen. Your life is full of people who care about you and would be happy to support you; don’t be too proud to ask for help if you need it. In general, you don’t like to boast about your successes. You understand that self-promotion can be useful, and you don’t judge others for doing so, but it just feels embarrassing and undignified when you try it. You’d rather step back and trust that your hard work will speak for itself. This week, though, your victories might go unnoticed if you don’t call attention to them. You deserve to be celebrated — or at the very least, credited for your contributions — so don’t hesitate to speak up for yourself. You often tell yourself that it’s important to pick your battles — if you use up all your energy fighting over the small stuff and trying to score minor points, then you’ll be left with no motivation when the truly important challenges come your way. But while this mind-set sometimes helps you to pace yourself, it can also mean that you’re always holding back a bit just in case something more important comes along later. This week, give yourself permission to stop reserving your energy for some undetermined future moment. You might as well use what you’ve got right now. Not every conflict with someone in your life needs to be dealt with directly — sometimes, the best course of action is to let the small stuff go, trusting that any tension will dissipate on its own over time. Most of the time, this works, but occasionally, minor frustrations can curdle into lasting resentments; the longer a problem goes unaddressed, the more bitter everyone involved starts to feel. This week, it might finally be your moment to address old problems head-on; everybody will feel better when you clear the air. When there are problems in your relationships, it’s easy to hold yourself responsible. If only you’d been more accommodating, if you’d made more of an effort to understand the other person’s needs, then everything would be different. But this week, remind yourself that relationships need to be reciprocal; you can’t do all the hard work on your own. If there are issues you’ve been struggling with, stop trying to fix them single-handedly, and start thinking about how you might solve them together, as a team. When you have extra mental energy, it’s not always easy to figure out how to use it. Often, you just end up ruminating on the same old problems, imagining that if you just think hard enough, you’ll find the perfect solution. In reality, though, your thoughts end up going in circles, and you never end up getting anywhere new. So this week, do your best not to get stuck in the trap of overthinking. You can avoid letting your energy go to waste by finding ways to take action. This is an excellent week for brainstorming and letting your imagination go a bit wild. The important thing is to have fun with it — don’t let yourself be held back by your sense of what’s feasible, or what you “should” do. Later on, you’ll have plenty of time to determine which of your ideas are worth seriously pursuing and which are just pipe dreams. For now, though, your inner critic won’t be as loud or insistent as usual, so take advantage of this opportunity to dream freely. You understand that people are complicated and imperfect, and that sometimes they’ll hurt you, probably without meaning to. When you know there were no bad intentions, you try to let it go; there’s no point in making a big drama over a minor issue. This week, though, you might discover that some of the things you thought you’d gotten over are actually still bothering you. The answer isn’t to suppress your emotions further but to tell your friends how you’re feeling so that you can resolve the issue together. It’s easy to imagine that growth should be linear, that the work you put in and the results you achieve should be directly correlated. In reality, though, things rarely work out this way. It’s possible to work yourself into the ground only to end up with nothing to show for it — or, conversely, to slack off and take shortcuts but then have a lucky break that allows you to enjoy huge success anyway. This week, the best thing you can do is accept that life will be unfair sometimes but to do your best anyway. This week, it could be easy to convince yourself that everyone else is looking down on you. Even if you think your life is wonderful, you worry that others won’t see it that way. You might start to imagine that you should make big changes — not because you actually want to, but because you think it might make others respect you more. But try to resist this impulse: Trying to become more similar to everyone else won’t improve your life, and in any case, others already admire you — not for conforming to the norm but for your stubborn individuality.
